title: GCE instances in a zone
description: Lists Compute Engine instances in one project and zone with status, machine type and creation time.

outputs.name: machineType
outputs.description: Machine type URL; the type name is the last path segment

cost.notes: One list call per project and zone when swept org-wide

template: SELECT name, status, machineType, zone, creationTimestamp FROM google.compute.instances WHERE project = '{{project}}' AND zone = '{{zone}}';
notes: machineType and zone are returned as full resource URLs; take the last path segment for the short name. TERMINATED in GCE means stopped, not deleted - stopped instances still appear here.
